crossRefs.note: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

translations.web: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
translations.bsb: You have made men like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler.
translations.kjv: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler
translations.asv: and makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
